sights.n: Asahikawa City Museum (旭川市博物館)
sights.w: The museum of the Kamikawa basin's Ainu culture and pioneer history, in the Taisetsu Crystal Hall by the Chūbetsu River — a full-scale chise house, ritual tools and the settlers' story.

sights.n: Ken & Mary Tree, Biei (ケンとメリーの木)
sights.w: The lone poplar on a Biei hill made famous by Nissan's 1972 'Ken & Mary' Skyline commercial — the tree that turned Biei's farm hills into a destination; 5 minutes by car from Biei Station, with a car park. Stay off the fields (private farmland).
